headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 flash sets a 30.8% all-time share record, and DeepSeek now holds 42.7% of tokens
summary: DeepSeek's deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 has taken the top spot with an all-time token-share record of 30.8%. Its provider sits at 42.7% of tokens, and DeepSeek and Zhipu AI together hold 53.5%.
highlights: Rank 1 is deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 at 30.8% of tokens, a new all-time high for a single model.
DeepSeek and Zhipu AI hold 53.5% between them, and adding OpenAI takes the top three to 60.4%.
Biggest one-day climber: qwen/qwen3.8-flash-20260826 jumped 17 places to 29th.
Biggest one-day faller: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 dropped 14 places to 20th.
Three fresh entrants debut at 44th, 46th and 47th: openai/gpt-5.6-sol-20260709, anthropic/claude-4.8-opus-20260528 and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-20261015.
Dropped off the board: thinkingmachines/inkling-20260715:free, openai/gpt-oss-120b and openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903.
